verdict.rationale: BugSnag's own CLI is documented as uploading files to improve the stacktraces in your errors (bugsnag-docs-45, bugsnag-probe-4), and the product targets mobile apps (bugsnag-docs-50). No evidence names dSYM, ProGuard/R8 mapping, or native (NDK/ELF) symbol uploads, and the source-map docs cover JavaScript only, so they don't transfer. missing for 10: explicit dSYM upload docs, ProGuard/R8 mapping upload docs, native/NDK symbol upload docs, evidence of symbolicated function names and line numbers in mobile crashes, independent or hands-on corroboration
